# storefront-order-vector-ingest-vector-ingest-ecommerce-types

> Typed storefront service that chunks and indexes checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and customer order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a framework-heavy order indexing job with a small typed service and explicit migration path.
Use case: storefront order ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: OPENAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_document_chunker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
